notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary object-attribute subscription lifecycle. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies passive and active subscriptions, passive-to-active discovery, ordinary attribute reflection, downgrade and reactivation, unsubscription, stable object identity lookups, and standard resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary object-class attribute publication, subscription, update, lookup, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
